limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study. Model accuracy is not claimed. The two runs on the same paper saved different Value amounts (1800000 and 18000 minor units); the guide makes no accuracy claim and a later supported answer may replace an Unverified value.
The Contract record does not show the run's model (V03); the guide now says so. The model was checked through the API (latestRun.model) against the connector's saved Model.

The app shows no per-value Invalid outcome; all three runs had invalid []. A value that fails validation after repair can be observed only as an unchanged value (author's limitation, not contradicted).
The Answer style radios stay usable while Use AI analysis is off (F01), as the author's limitation says.

Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Groq and Ollama were checked for their form controls only. Ollama Load models failed from the app container's own localhost, as the guide describes. No account for the other providers was used.
Provider refusal was shown as HTTP 400 (invalid model), 401 (fake key) and 404 (missing endpoint path). No timeout or rate-limit refusal was produced.
Removing a Field's prompt before a later run was not exercised, to stay within five Analysis runs.
Reviewer script errors are kept under earlierAttempts in walkthrough.json (page reload on the landing page, radio check()). They were fixed and re-run; none was a guide or product failure.
The lab live2 was destroyed after the walk, with the connector removed and the Saved key forgotten.
